svg.title: How to use the auth method readiness groups
svg.desc: The telephony-only group is the migration list. Point a Conditional Access report-only policy at it, hand it to the service desk and run a registration campaign, and it shrinks each run until nobody relies on phone codes. The phishing-resistant and strong groups sit under a parent group that a Conditional Access policy targets with an authentication strength that leaves out SMS and voice. The no-method, review and non-human groups are onboarded, triaged or kept out of user policies.
